title: 十三张牌背
intendedUse: 52 张牌背统一纹样，正反翻转由 PixiJS 控制
prompt: Create a single vertical playing-card back, viewed straight-on, with a symmetrical abstract geometric pattern inspired by folded card fans and woven emerald felt. Deep green/teal base, warm-ivory fine geometry and a restrained polished-gold double border. Match the specific Shisanshui game-room material style. Keep the pattern perfectly non-semantic and rotationally balanced; no text, ranks, suit symbols, logo or identifiable number.
negativePrompt: face side, card ranks, letters, numbers, suit pips, asymmetrical layout, perspective view, real casino branding, photorealism, watermark, excessive gold, clutter

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match dedicated-game palette, rendering and surface material; do not copy the room composition.
